main_text.p: 40 Tribui filiorum Dan per familias suas exiuit sors septima.
41 Fuítque terminus hæreditatis eorum, Sorah, & Esthaol, & Itsemes,
46 Et Mehaiarcon, & Raccon cum termino contra Iapho.

47 Et exiuit terminus filiorum Dan ab eis: ascenderuntque filii Dan, & pugnauerunt cum Lesem, ceperúntque eam, ac percusserūt eam acie gladii, & hæreditate acceperunt eam, habitauerúntque in ea: & vocauerūt Lesem Dan secundum nomen Dan patris sui.

page.notes: Catchword "Hæc" at lower right, which also begins the next verse; the line "48 Hæc" is printed at right and is kept as the catchword. Some words are uncertain in the scan, including the Latin spelling of "ascenderunt" (printed "afcéderúntque") and the Hebrew place names, which were read as printed.
